answer: Call it a silicon-seeded liveness escrow. A newcomer locks 0.05 ETH plus a nonce signed by its secure element, so one chip yields one key. Every seven days a randomized liveness challenge fires; miss twice and 20% of the bond gets slashed, while a second identity from that chip must post ten times as much. The bond refunds after a 90-day cooldown. Forging a thousand IDs costs 50 ETH (~$150,000) parked a quarter, 1,000 distinct chips (~$2,000), and ~600 hours of human liveness work. A sybil tide breaks on the orchard wall when every sparrow must carry its own stone.
